scripts.dev: npm run build -w @marido/contracts && concurrently --kill-others --names contracts,api,web --prefix-colors cyan,green,yellow "npm run dev -w @marido/contracts" "npm run dev -w @marido/api" "npm run dev -w @marido/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @marido/contracts && npm run dev -w @marido/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @marido/contracts && npm run dev -w @marido/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @marido/contracts && npm run build -w @marido/api && npm run build -w @marido/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @marido/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @marido/api && npm run typecheck -w @marido/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @marido/contracts && npm run test -w @marido/contracts && npm run test -w @marido/api && npm run test -w @marido/web
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
